core.scope: kernel_optimizer Python sources and role prompts at worker entry

native.scope: Exact candidate, separately perturbed native profile. Not clean timing or isolated critical-path/host-cost evidence.

fsdp.scope: Prior independent full source comparison retained; actual reference hashes rechecked. Candidate comparisons use these source-verified baseline references.

source_evidence_reuse.scope: Reused independent source/control comparisons with exact hashes. No new numerical source fixture, model run or reference copy. Qwen manual mapping and FSDP developer-assisted 512-byte owner repair remain explicit; arbitrary extra owners are not certified.

limits: Source comparisons reused by exact identity, not a new source numerical rerun; manual mapping and owner repair boundaries remain.
Generated fixed versions have independent decisions but no preceding autonomous search acceptance or unaided original-entry claim.
No prompt/sampler/allocator adoption; bounded prompt/verifier studies remain closed.
All samples retained. Different communication metrics use distinct invocations, not composable physical costs.
One new Qwen candidate native only; no paired native baseline or unique causal attribution.

measurement.protocol: AB then BA in fresh workers; median within each endpoint; every pair must exceed its MAD-derived noise bound

fixed-index-read-qwen.interpretation: Reference counters observe calls through context.references only, not all possible captured aliases. A reference call may be fallback or part of a composite; declared route labels are candidate telemetry, not independent proof. Corroborate implementation with traces.
